name: dumbbell one arm reverse spider curl
description: A one-arm reverse spider curl, with an overhand grip over a bench. It works the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with your feet on the floor.
Let one arm hang straight down holding a dumbbell with an overhand grip, and hold the bench with the other hand.
Keep your upper arm still and curl the dumbbell up.
Lower slowly to a straight arm, finish the reps, then switch arms.
